title: This Boring Daily Routine Got Me Abs At 41
hook: My daily routine is boring, and that's exactly why I have six pack abs at 41.
body: I wake up between 8 and 9:30 without an alarm, get some morning sun and have black cold brew. Then it's the gym about 9:30 to 10:30, seven days a week, with the same total body structure every day. After training, I take my supplements and eat some protein. My daily salad is at 2pm, with prepared meals later. I aim for bed at 10pm, but usually it's 11 or 11:30. Weekends look almost exactly like weekdays. When you stop deciding whether to work out or what to eat every day, it's so much easier to stay consistent. You don't have to depend on motivation.
